Combined Synopsis/Solicitation This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number OMAS-FDA-NCTR-2026-132591 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Pristima® Pre-Clinical Data Management System Maintenance and Support. This acquisition is not set aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at Acquisition.gov.
